profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Globality, Inc.
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Computer Engineer with cross-functional expertise in Web & Mobile applications development. More than thirteen years of experience analyzing and building solutions, combining strong developer skills with learnability to positively contribute to satisfy customer expectations. Proven history of solving huge problems and reducing development time.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: First Front-End developer that joined the company to build the new Casebook PBC platform. In charge of designing and building the architecture of Web and GraphQL platform areas. Working in a Lead developer role I have the responsibility of supervising other developers work and to provide to them tools needed in order to maximize company's productivity. Always in direct communication with company's CTO, I have contributed to promote coding best practices, to create an appropriate testing strategy and to help on new developers hiring process among other things. Technology stack used at Casebook PBC is : React, Typescript, NodeJS, ExpressJS, GraphQL, Webpack, Jest and Cypress

positions.title: Front-end Engineer
positions.description: My work experience within Spotahome is divided into two stages. During the first months I was part of Dreyhub team adding new features to a web application for the management of rental properties built using Angular 6. Afterwards, I became part of the Connect team where I lead the reconstruction from scratch of the Spotahome's landlord-panel using technologies such as React, Emotion, NodeJS, Express or GraphQL among others.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: As a freelance developer I worked creating a wide variety of projects, most of them along my spare time for local stores or small companies. I enjoyed developing al kind of different applications from mobile solutions on iOS, Android and Windows Phone devices to Web pages built with JavaScript, ASP.NET and much others.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: I worked along eight months as Consultant. I lead a project for Naturgas company. Project consisted on building a web solution to manage all the operations related with LPG deposits like downloads, consumes, failures... Technologies used to develop this application were AngularJS + Bootstrap for the front side and NodeJS + Express + MySQL for the backend. In order to achieve best performance and an excellent user experience in mobility a native Android application was also created embedding this solution inside a WebView. This allowed us to cache server requests, store information locally until network connection was restored and also take photos of deposits status while maintenance operations.

positions.title: GIS Analyst
positions.description: I started working at Eptisa TI as a Senior Developer but after some months I was promoted to Software Analyst. Mainly focused on GIS solutions development for Web and mobile platforms. Along the nine years I worked there I was involved in projects for big Spanish corporations such as Telefónica Movistar, Euskaltel or Canal de Isabel II among others.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Development of mobile and web solutions

projects.title: Casebook PBC Platform
projects.description: Lead React and GraphQL developer of a Web platform to manage human services. As first Front-End developer who joined the company to build the platform I was the responsible for designing and building the whole architecture on the Front-End side. Right now I am in charge of supervising other developers work and to provide to them tools needed to maximize company's productivity by creating Core libraries and promoting coding best practices.

projects.title: Orders diary REST API and IOS application
projects.description: Design and development of a REST API following Domain Driven Design (DDD) principles and based on hexagonal arquitecture. API was built using NodeJS + Express on TypeScript language to achieve the perfect balance between Object Oriented and Functional programing. Application data is stored in a MongoDB cluster. API is deployed in AWS using Amazon Container Service (ECS). This services is consumed by a React-Native iOS application published on the App Store also developed by me.
